title: Paying-History Allowance on Home-Visit Settlements
content:
## Clause — Specimen Collection Appointments, Mobile In-Home Collection Visit

The settlement of a collected home visit carries a paying-history allowance set by the payments received on the patient's test invoices in Patient Invoices & Statements during the last 12 months, counting each payment received on any of the patient's invoices.

When three or more payments were received on the patient's test invoices in the last 12 months the allowance is 3 percent, when one or two were received it is 1 percent, and when none was received there is none.

| Payments received on the patient's test invoices, last 12 months | Paying-history allowance |
|---|---|
| Three or more | 3 percent |
| One or two | 1 percent |
| None | None |

### Readings (hypothetical patients)

- Four payments received over the last 12 months: 3 percent.
- Exactly three: 3 percent. Exactly two: 1 percent.
- One payment received 14 months ago and none since: none — it falls outside the 12 months.
